classes.description: Bill of Materials — 定义制造一个产品所需的所有物料及其数量的主清单。BOM 包含多个 ProductMaterialListItem，每个 ProductMaterialListItem 指定一种物料及其需求数量。BOM 是连接 Product 和 Material 的核心枢纽：Product 通过 HAS_BOM 关联 BOM，MfgOrder 通过 BOM 的 RESOLVES_MATERIALS_FROM_BOM 解析运行时的物料需求。 【Swagger】Schema: BOMEntity；来源文件: BOMs.json；API: /api/BOMs。

properties.name: bomBase
properties.description: BOM 基线引用 → BOM

properties.name: setupAccess
properties.description: 换线设置权限 → SetupAccess 【Swagger】引用 Schema: NamedObjectRef。

properties.name: changeHistory
properties.description: 关联的变更历史记录（ChangeStatus）。 【Swagger】引用 Schema: ChangeHistoryChanges。

properties.name: iconId
properties.description: 关联图标的标识符。 【Swagger】Identifier for the icon associated with this Base Entity

properties.name: isFrozen
properties.description: 是否已冻结，冻结后不可修改（只读） 【Swagger】Determines if changes are allowed to this instance

properties.name: revision
properties.description: BOM 版本号（必填） 【Swagger】Revision (unique within the context of the base entity)

properties.name: status
properties.description: 状态：1=Active（启用）, 2=Inactive（停用） 【Swagger】Determines the current status (Active, In-Active) of this instance. Valid values and their meanings are: 1 = Active 2 = Inactive

properties.name: wipMsgDefMgr
properties.description: 关联的 WIP 消息定义管理器 【Swagger】引用 Schema: WIPMsgEntity。

properties.name: billType
properties.description: BOM 类型（如 Manufacturing=制造BOM, Engineering=工程BOM, Phantom=虚拟BOM） 【Swagger】引用 Schema: NamedObjectRef。

properties.name: description
properties.description: BOM 的描述说明 【Swagger】Description of this entity. Defaults to the name of this entity if not specified

properties.name: notes
properties.description: 内部备注信息 【Swagger】Notations and comments associated with this object.

properties.name: eco
properties.description: 关联的工程变更单号（Engineering Change Order） 【Swagger】Engineering Change Order

properties.name: filterTags
properties.description: 分类筛选标签（逗号分隔） 【Swagger】FilterTags comma seperated list

classes.description: ProductMaterialListItem — BOM 中的一行物料需求记录。每个 ProductMaterialListItem 引用一个具体的 Product/Material，并指定所需数量、单位、发行控制策略等。在 Camstar 中以 ProductMaterialListItem 形式存在，区别于工单级别的 MfgOrderMaterialListItem（工单运行时快照）。 【Swagger】Schema: ProductMaterialListItemChanges；来源文件: BOMs.json；API: /api/BOMs。

properties.name: isSourceProduct
properties.description: 物理字段 IsSourceProduct 【Swagger】Flag indicating whether the Product should be used as the source material to build the target Product.

properties.name: ssStep
properties.description: 物理字段 ss_StepId → WorkflowStep

properties.name: ssWfStackKey
properties.description: 物理字段 ss_WfStackKey

properties.name: ssWorkflow
properties.description: 物理字段 ss_WorkflowId → Workflow

properties.name: scsIsComponentIssue
properties.description: 物理字段 scsIsComponentIssue 【Swagger】Flag to denote if the material is to be consumed via CEP Component Issue or SCS Material Consumption logic

properties.name: isImage
properties.description: 图像引用 【Swagger】引用 Schema: RevisionedObjectRef。

properties.name: allowSubstitution
properties.description: 是否允许使用替代料 【Swagger】Allow substitution of the product to be issued.

properties.name: setupQty2
properties.description: 辅助初始化数量 【Swagger】The amount of this component item needed to initialize the processing resource.

properties.name: effectiveThruDate
properties.description: 生效截止日期 【Swagger】If specified, this is the ending date and time when this Bin becomes no longer available.

properties.name: uom
properties.description: 主计量单位 → UOM 【Swagger】引用 Schema: NamedObjectRef。

properties.name: uom2
properties.description: 辅助计量单位 → UOM

properties.name: effectiveFromDate
properties.description: 生效开始日期 【Swagger】If specified, this is the starting date and time when this Path Selector becomes available.

properties.name: effectiveThruDateGmt
properties.description: 物理字段 EffectiveThruDateGMT

properties.name: referenceDesignator
properties.description: 装配位号（如 PCB 上的丝印位号 R1, C3） 【Swagger】The specific position on or in the assembly where this item is placed.

properties.name: vendorControl
properties.description: 是否需要供应商信息 【Swagger】Denotes whether Vendor information is required for this item.

properties.name: qtyRequired
properties.description: 需求数量（必填） 【Swagger】Quantity of this component item required.

properties.name: qty2Required
properties.description: 辅助数量（如重量或替代单位） 【Swagger】Quantity of this component item required, if multiple quantities are being tracked.

properties.name: setupQty
properties.description: 初始化/准备数量 【Swagger】The amount of this component item needed to initialize the processing resource.

properties.name: scrapPercent
properties.description: 预期报废百分比 【Swagger】Percent of this item expected to be scrapped.

properties.name: effectiveFromDateGmt
properties.description: 物理字段 EffectiveFromDateGMT

properties.name: allowOverConsumption
properties.description: 是否允许超发料 【Swagger】This flag determines if the material consumption check will allow more materials to be issued than specified in the MaterialListItem entry

properties.name: allowUnderConsumption
properties.description: 是否允许少发料 【Swagger】This flag determines if the material consumption check will allow less materials to be issued than specified in the MaterialListItem entry

properties.name: isFrozen
properties.description: 是否已冻结（只读） 【Swagger】Determines if changes are allowed to this instance (or any of its revisions)

properties.name: materialTxnLogic
properties.description: 物理字段 MaterialTxnLogic

properties.name: name
properties.description: 物料行名称 【Swagger】Unique name for the name subentity.

properties.name: phantomBill
properties.description: 虚拟件引用的下层BOM → BOM 【Swagger】引用 Schema: RevisionedObjectRef。

properties.name: bom
properties.description: 所属主BOM → BOM

properties.name: adjustmentValue
properties.description: 自动调整数值 【Swagger】This field defines the value used for auto-adjustments calculations based on the chosen Adjustment Type.

properties.name: adjustmentType
properties.description: 调整类型（百分比或固定数量） 【Swagger】This field defines the type of the adjustment (e.g. Percentage or Quantity). The chosen type determines how the AdjustmentValue is interpreted and applied for the auto-adjustment calculations.

properties.name: qtyIssued
properties.description: 已发行消耗的材料数量（只读） 【Swagger】Material quantity (individual) that has been issued for the item

properties.name: allowAllRevisionsAsSubstitute
properties.description: 是否允许所有版本作为替代料 【Swagger】When true it will allow all revisions of the product to be allowed for the material requirement

properties.name: assemblySequence
properties.description: 装配顺序 【Swagger】Sequence the item should be assembled. The value is only used if the item is assigned to a Step/Spec
